text: Based on Earth-observation data analyzed, **no deforestation occurred on this asset after 2020**. The assessment (status: *NOT_DETECTED*) confirms no tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger between 2021 and 2025. While minor loss (0.4 ha in 2021) was observed, it fell below the minimum detectable threshold. All valid observation sources (Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020) agree, with full spatial coverage (100%) of the asset. The claim interval (2021–2025) is fully covered by annual data, and no events meet the criteria for deforestation.
